title: 過渡現象論
subtitle: Transient Phenomena in Linear Circuits
keywords: Transient Analysis 2.Circuit Equation 3.Laplace Transform 4.Transient Phenomena 5.Regional Collaboration
educationalGoal: The aim of this course is to help students acquire the necessary knowledge needed to understand the theory to learn in “Feedback Control” course in the 5th term. Students will: (1) solve transient electrical circuits using circuit equations and initial conditions. (2) analyze transient phenomena of more complex circuits by Laplace transform. (3) understand the various transient phenomena that occur in electrical circuits.
advice: 1. Transient phenomena and differential equation (circuit equations) Learn the basics needed to analyze transient phenomena. //Transient phenomena and steady phenomena, differential equations of electrical circuits and its solutions 2. Transient phenomena of electrical circuits Solve the transient phenomena of various circuits according to the solution of differential equation. //AC and DC circuit of RC, RL, LC, and LCR 3. Analysis by Laplace transform Learn how to analyze transient phenomena in electrical circuits using Laplace transform. //Laplace transform and inverse transform, Laplace transform for functions and its application to circuits. There is possibility to change the learning contents (progress) of the course schedule depending on the situation. Exercises, quizzes, discussions and questions, etc. are included to help students concentrate on this class. The course schedule may be changed depending on “Humanity and Nature Seminar” schedule.
books: Textbooks: The basics of transient phenomena (in Japanese)
requiredKnowledge: 1. Fundamentals of electrical circuits. 2. Fundamentals of mathematics such as exponential, trigonometric function, differential and integral, etc. 3. Attitude to take each class seriously and review and deepen understanding. 4. Attitude to learn theoretical thinking and applied methods through exercises without relying on memorization.

activityGoals.body: Be able to show circuit equations (differential equation) from electric circuits.
Be able to show initial conditions from electric circuits and apply to circuit equations.
Be able to solve differential equations and express the transient phenomenon with equations.
Be able to graph transient phenomena based on the equations.
Be able to understand Laplace transform.
Be able to solve transient phenomena of electrical circuits by Laplace transform.
